syncSegmentsEn.text: Lord, I ask for nothing, I ask for nothing, Jesus
If I have lost those wide-open eyes
Give me back those dove-like eyes, give them back to me
If my heart is no longer still
If that playful west wind has rippled its surface
Give me back the quiet of still autumn waters
Lord, I have nothing, I have nothing
I received life and grace freely from You
Lord, I ask for nothing, I ask for nothing
I ask only that my life not be lost in eternity
If my feet have lost the steadiness they once had
Lord, help me stand firm on both feet and give me strength
If my heart is no longer at peace
If it has been swept away by the world around me
Give me back the peace I knew amid wind and rain
Though I have nothing, I have nothing
Yet You have let me have everything
Lord, I ask for nothing, I ask for nothing
Only keep this childlike heart uncreased
Though I have nothing, I have nothing
Yet You have let me have everything
Lord, I ask for nothing, I ask for nothing
Only keep this childlike heart uncreased
Lord, I am not the owner, I am not the owner
May I never keep Your grace to myself
I will answer Your grace and be a steward of what You entrust to me
The Lord is the surest thing in my life
The Lord is the surest thing in my life
